scope: Fresh fictional private mandates on previously audited historical families and existing workshop package menus. References are evaluator-only.

cards.prose: For this workshop, the public record of the review must use aggregate reporting and be issued once per year. I can work with any of the proposed conveners if those two conditions hold.
The review is within my workshop mandate only if the Emergency Relief Coordinator convenes it and the schedule is yearly. Either kind of public report would be acceptable.

I can consider any of the proposed products, but my workshop mandate requires both a renewed review of a possible membership recommendation and work on a humanitarian pause in parallel. A pause-first sequence does not satisfy the instruction.

I have no workshop restriction on the scope or timing of the agenda. I can accept a package only if its product is the written options note. An informal dialogue or chair consultations would fall outside this instruction.
